Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Galu Wyro: 34-year-old man, 153 cm (very-short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: broad oval face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a carved belt buckle; contrasting boot laces; a patterned collar insert. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
